records.name: Friends of Kahn Park
records.summary: Neighbors who help look after Louis I. Kahn Park at 11th and Pine streets. A garden team tends its plants and trees, and the group runs free summer concerts, a children's party, a spring cleanup, and a Halloween pumpkin contest.
records.what_you_do: Come to the free concerts and family events, join a park cleanup when one is held, or email the group to ask how to help the garden team.

schedule.text: Free summer concerts on Wednesdays at 7:30 pm, plus a children's party, a Love Your Park cleanup in May, and a Halloween pumpkin contest. The events page has the dates.

cost.text: Summer concerts are free. The group asks for donations on its support page.

first_step.how: Email kahnparkphilly@gmail.com to ask about the Halloween pumpkin contest or how to help the garden team
first_step.basis: Free public concerts and events are open to anyone, and the site gives an email address for questions. No membership process is described.

records.notes: Dated items on /events: concerts 2026-06-17, 2026-07-15, 2026-08-19 and 2026-09-09; children's party 2026-06-13; Love Your Park cleanup 2026-05-09. The Halloween pumpkin contest has no date shown. The homepage had no dates and mentions a Halloween party. Facebook and Instagram were not read. Aka 'Louis I Kahn Park' on the City list; the group calls itself Friends of Kahn Park. The group's own site is the main source.

records.name: The Friends of Mario Lanza Park
records.summary: Volunteers who look after this small, historic park in Queen Village. They handle upkeep and plantings, and they run events: KidFest in June, Movie Nights in July, and Music Month in September.
records.what_you_do: Join a cleanup or planting day, or help with the summer events. Email the group to learn how to get involved.

schedule.text: Cleanups and plantings, KidFest (June), Movie Nights (July), and Music Month (September). The page gives no exact dates.

first_step.how: Email friends-mariolanzapark@qvna.org to learn how to get involved and volunteer
first_step.basis: The page invites anyone to email the group to get involved. The way in is clear, but no work-day schedule is listed.

records.notes: The page sits on the Queen Village Neighbors Association (QVNA) site and reads as QVNA's. The only explicit date on the page is a 2011 lawn re-sodding item, and the event list has no dates. Status is probably_active from a working site with no dated posts. If you want a stricter rule, change it to unknown. QVNA's own social links are not recorded, since they are not this group's. The page says the group formed in 1987. No phone listed.

notes: 15 City-listed Friends groups. WebSearch: 3 of 3 used (Konrad Square, Lemon Hill Neighbors, Manayunk Bridge Park), so the other 12 are City-list-only or rest on their own site. WebFetch: 9 used. Only Friends of Kahn Park (active, dated 2026 events, high confidence) and The Friends of Mario Lanza Park (probably_active, undated, low confidence) had their own usable pages. The Malcolm X Park website returned 404 twice. The City's park Friends list page is an interactive map whose entries did not load, so group websites could not be read from it. The pprstewardship@phila.gov address appears only in first_step.how, never in contacts.email. Outside this batch: The Spring Gardens (thespringgardens.org), named on the 2022 Park Friends list, was fetched: a volunteer community garden with resident membership and a waitlist, no dated items. It is dropped from leads_only because it is outside this batch and was checked here. No 403s, bot checks or paywalls were hit. Roxborough Manayunk Conservancy is named in a local mirror report with no URL, noted in the Lauriston record only.
